# GovTec, the Governance & Technology Centre

> Global news and intelligence on e-governance, digital public infrastructure (digital ID, digital payments, data exchange, civil registration), AI governance, cybersecurity and the digitalisation of sectors (fintech and payments, health, education, agriculture, social protection, telecom, trade, energy). Every item is written from original sources (governments, central banks, regulators, UN agencies, the World Bank, expert bodies and major media) and links to them. Free for everyone; content in English, with French, Spanish and Arabic versions of recent news.

Updated 26 Nov 2026. 162 news items, 5 in-depth analyses, 28 full country profiles and pages for all 193 UN member states, 76 upcoming events and 83 open grants, fellowships and jobs.

## Main sections
- [News](https://govtec.org/news/): daily news, newest first
- [Analysis](https://govtec.org/analysis/): weekly in-depth analysis with numbered sources
- [Countries](https://govtec.org/countries/): digital government profiles and UN E-Government Development Index 2024 rankings for all 193 UN member states
- [Regions](https://govtec.org/regions/): [Africa](https://govtec.org/regions/africa/), [Americas](https://govtec.org/regions/americas/), [Asia-Pacific](https://govtec.org/regions/asia-pacific/), [Europe](https://govtec.org/regions/europe/), [Middle East](https://govtec.org/regions/middle-east/), [Global](https://govtec.org/regions/global/)
- [Policy & Law Tracker](https://govtec.org/policy-tracker/): AI, data protection, cybersecurity and DPI laws worldwide
- [Events](https://govtec.org/events/): conferences, workshops and webinars on digital government
- [Grants, fellowships and jobs](https://govtec.org/funding/)
- [Glossary](https://govtec.org/glossary/)
- Topics: [E-governance & services](https://govtec.org/topics/egov/), [Digital Public Infrastructure](https://govtec.org/topics/dpi/), [Digital governance & policy](https://govtec.org/topics/pol/), [Artificial intelligence](https://govtec.org/topics/ai/), [Cybersecurity](https://govtec.org/topics/cyb/), [Sector digitalisation](https://govtec.org/topics/sec/), [Green digitalisation](https://govtec.org/topics/grn/), [Enabling areas](https://govtec.org/topics/enb/)
- Sectors: [Government](https://govtec.org/sectors/government/), [Fintech & payments](https://govtec.org/sectors/fintech-and-payments/), [Health](https://govtec.org/sectors/health/), [Education](https://govtec.org/sectors/education/), [Agriculture](https://govtec.org/sectors/agriculture/), [Social protection](https://govtec.org/sectors/social-protection/), [Telecom](https://govtec.org/sectors/telecom/), [Trade & business](https://govtec.org/sectors/trade-and-business/), [Energy & climate](https://govtec.org/sectors/energy-and-climate/)
- Other languages: [Français](https://govtec.org/fr/), [Español](https://govtec.org/es/), [العربية](https://govtec.org/ar/)
- [RSS feed](https://govtec.org/feed.xml)
